Title: Add shop holiday with missing shopId
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/shop-holidays/add with the payload in testData. 2. Verify the response.

Test Data: {"shopId": null, "holidayDate": "2024-01-01", "reason": "New Year"}
Expected Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request with error message indicating shopId is required

Steps:

Test Data: {"shopId": 1, "holidayDate": "invalid-date", "reason": "New Year"}
Expected Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request with error message indicating holidayDate format is invalid

Title: Add shop holiday with duplicate date
Preconditions: Shop holiday endpoint is available and a holiday already exists for the shop on the given date
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/shop-holidays/add with the payload in testData. 2. Verify the response.

Test Data: {"shopId": 1, "holidayDate": "2024-01-01", "reason": "New Year"}
Expected Result: HTTP 409 Conflict with error message indicating shop already has a holiday on the given date
